label: Non-specific low back pain / lumbar strain-sprain
definition: Axial low back pain without radicular findings, fracture or specific structural pathology; includes lumbar sprain/strain and muscle spasm. Corresponds to AMA Guides lumbar non-specific/soft-tissue rows.

label: Lumbar disc herniation with radiculopathy (sciatica)
definition: Lumbar/lumbosacral disc herniation or displacement with concordant radicular pain, sensory or motor findings; includes sciatica and lumbar radiculopathy codes when a compressive disc lesion is the presumed cause.

label: Degenerative lumbar spinal stenosis (neurogenic claudication / radiculopathy)
definition: Central, lateral recess or foraminal stenosis from degenerative change producing neurogenic claudication and/or radiculopathy, without significant spondylolisthesis.

label: Lumbar spondylolisthesis / spondylolysis (degenerative or isthmic)
definition: Degenerative or isthmic (pars defect) slip or segmental instability, with axial pain and/or stenosis-type symptoms (claudication, radiculopathy).

label: Lumbar facet arthropathy / degenerative disc disease (axial spondylotic or discogenic pain)
definition: Chronic axial low back pain attributed to facet (zygapophyseal) arthropathy, spondylosis or disc degeneration without radiculopathy, stenosis or instability; includes vertebrogenic low back pain (M54.51).

label: Lumbar vertebral fracture / dislocation (traumatic or osteoporotic compression)
definition: Traumatic fractures or dislocations of lumbar vertebrae and osteoporotic/insufficiency compression fractures. M80.08 is not region-specific; resolve region from documentation.

label: Post-surgical lumbar spine / failed back surgery syndrome
definition: Persistent or recurrent pain after lumbar spine surgery (post-laminectomy syndrome, pseudarthrosis, adjacent-segment disease, epidural fibrosis). M96.1, M96.0 and Z98.1 are not region-specific; resolve region from operative history.

label: Non-specific neck pain / cervical strain-sprain (incl. whiplash-associated disorder)
definition: Axial neck pain without radicular or myelopathic findings, fracture or specific structural pathology; includes cervical sprain/strain and whiplash-associated disorder grades I-II.

label: Cervical radiculopathy (disc herniation or foraminal stenosis)
definition: Cervical nerve-root compression from disc herniation or spondylotic foraminal stenosis with concordant radicular pain, sensory, motor or reflex findings (NASS degenerative cervical radiculopathy).

label: Degenerative cervical myelopathy / central canal stenosis
definition: Spinal cord compression from spondylosis, disc disease, OPLL or central stenosis with or without clinical myelopathy.

label: Cervical facet arthropathy / degenerative disc disease (axial spondylosis)
definition: Chronic axial neck pain (with or without cervicogenic headache) attributed to facet arthropathy, spondylosis or disc degeneration without radiculopathy or myelopathy.

label: Cervical vertebral fracture / dislocation
definition: Traumatic fracture, subluxation or dislocation of C1-C7 and pathological/collapsed cervical vertebra.

label: Post-surgical cervical spine (post-laminectomy syndrome, pseudarthrosis, adjacent segment)
definition: Persistent or recurrent neck/arm pain after cervical spine surgery. M96.1, M96.0 and Z98.1 are not region-specific; resolve region from operative history.

label: Non-specific thoracic pain / thoracic strain-sprain
definition: Mid-back pain without radicular or myelopathic findings, fracture or specific structural pathology; includes thoracic sprain/strain and muscle spasm.

label: Thoracic disc herniation with radiculopathy
definition: Thoracic or thoracolumbar disc herniation/spondylosis with concordant thoracic radicular (band-like intercostal) pain, without myelopathy.

label: Thoracic stenosis / myelopathy (disc, OLF, spondylosis)
definition: Thoracic spinal cord compression from disc herniation, ossified ligamentum flavum or spondylosis with myelopathic signs or high-grade stenosis.

label: Thoracic facet arthropathy / degenerative disc disease (axial spondylosis)
definition: Chronic axial thoracic pain attributed to spondylosis, facet arthropathy or disc degeneration without radiculopathy or myelopathy.

label: Thoracic vertebral fracture / dislocation (traumatic or osteoporotic compression)
definition: Traumatic fracture, subluxation or dislocation of T1-T12 and osteoporotic/insufficiency compression fractures. M80.08 is not region-specific; resolve region from documentation.
